description: Questions written by independent agents with no access to this repository or to the trigger (asks_if_notice_event_caused). Positives ask whether a grid incident of the kind AEMO reports in a market notice influenced a price or market event; negatives name other causes (a), ask only for facts about equipment or notices (b), or ask about forecasts (c). The trigger_sha256 is of the INFLUENCE_Q_RE/INCIDENT_Q_RE source block when scored.
